title: Web console state machine and inline action rows

contracts.singleSubmitEntry: submitMessage(opts) is the only Web console /message POST path.
contracts.dedupe: renderSubmitFailureOnce uses dataset.submitFailureRendered so one failed send renders one recovery/action prompt.
contracts.projectionActionPlans: RuntimeProjectionService exposes sanitized action_plans for permission.requested and capability.policy_blocked events.

reviewFixes.stalePermissionRows: Permission confirm action plans are omitted once projection state is no longer waiting_permission, and frontend projection sync removes stale inline rows.
reviewFixes.sseTerminalRows: applyRuntimeProjectionSnapshot uses syncInlineActionRows so live SSE terminal refresh also removes stale permission rows.
reviewFixes.actionPlanOnlyRecovery: Runtime projection action plans now make a request renderable and are carried into newly created bot bubbles.
reviewFixes.submitPermissionAction: Submit-error permission rows use view_capability_policy instead of the removed open_permissions action.
reviewFixes.submitFailurePhase: renderSubmitFailureOnce removes the stale agent-current-phase before showing an error/action row.
reviewFixes.behavioralSmoke: scripts/smoke-s7-inline-actions.js executes console.js helper code against a minimal DOM shim.

notes: Inline rows render deterministic actions but do not introduce a Web-only repair executor.
Capability policy rows navigate to existing management/diagnostic surfaces instead of bypassing S3/S4 installer contracts.

tests.command: $env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1'; python -m pytest tests/test_ecorex_web_parallel_backend.py -q -k "runtime_projection_api_returns_request_and_session_projection or web_stream_terminal_and_loss_converge_from_runtime_projection or web_history_load_refreshes_session_runtime_projection or web_runtime_real_network_browser_smoke_harness_contract or frontend_has_typed_runtime_projection_fetch_contract"

warnings: pydub reported a local ffmpeg/avconv warning in imported test paths.
Python reported audioop and setDaemon deprecation warnings from pre-existing code paths.
notes: S7 keeps Web console recovery on SSE plus runtime projection and active request snapshots.
sendMessage, sendVoiceMessage, and regenerateResponse now converge through submitMessage(opts).
History load, stream loss, window focus, and visibility restore paths all re-check active runtime requests.
Inline action rows consume S5/S6/S7 contracts and provide a common visual row for permission, credential, repair, and policy states.
Terminal projections no longer resurrect stale Allow/Deny permission rows.
Projection-only permission/policy rows are renderable even without tool calls or assistant text.
Image generation remains pinned by S4b/S6 and is not changed by this slice.
